newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips extend fall, Dow off 50 points.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips extend fall, Dow off 50 points.

text.p: The Dow industrials dipped to session lows in the final minutes of trading on Monday, triggering New York Stock Exchange program trading curbs.
The Dow industrials were off 51 points at 7280. The NYSE imposed its index-arbitrage curbs at 1555 EDT/1955 GMT.

The Dow's weakness failed to carry over into the broad market. Breadth on the New York Stock Exchange favored advancers by a five to three margin and the AMEX and Nasdaq Composite indexes were both slightly higher.
